# WebLLM files bundled for offline use

These files are third-party software, copied unchanged so the AI on this computer starts with no code from the internet.

| File | Where it comes from | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| `web-llm.js` | `lib/index.js` of the npm package `@mlc-ai/web-llm` version 0.2.87 (MLC project), https://www.npmjs.com/package/@mlc-ai/web-llm, renamed | Apache License 2.0 (`LICENSE`) |
| `libs/Qwen2-1.5B-Instruct-q4f16_1_cs1k-webgpu.wasm` | The compiled WebGPU program for the model, https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mlc-ai/binary-mlc-llm-libs/main/web-llm-models/v0_2_87/base/Qwen2-1.5B-Instruct-q4f16_1_cs1k-webgpu.wasm | The repository has no licence file; it is built from Apache-2.0 sources (MLC LLM, Apache TVM). To confirm with the MLC project. |

The model weights are not in this folder (about 880 MB). The public demo downloads them once from Hugging Face, `mlc-ai/Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct-q4f16_1-MLC` at revision `9bd564b064631febf14deadcac492efb761d60c3`, after the person agrees on screen. An on-board install puts the same files in `assets/models/` with `node tools/fetch-model.mjs`. The model is Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct by Alibaba Cloud's Qwen team, Apache License 2.0: https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct

The configuration, the tokenizer and the WebGPU program are pinned by their SHA-256 (src/ai.js), and WebLLM refuses a file that does not match.
